description: Attach a Google Place to an ALREADY-EXISTING segment retroactively — writes a place association and syncs the segment's address/city/country/coordinates from the place. Use when a segment has a venue/name but no address (e.g. imported from a ticket confirmation with venue-only data). Requires a place_id from places_search/place_details. For CarRental/Transfer segments pass role "origin" or "destination"; omit for single-location segments (Activity, Lodging, EventTicket, Parking), which default to "primary".

place_id.description: Google Place ID from a prior places_search/place_details call.

role.description: Which location this place represents. Default "primary".

segment_id.description: Segment ID (from segment_details/trip_details) to attach the place to.

name: segment_associate_place
title: Associate Place With Segment
